task: Section 6-7: the predefined representation search space, declared before evaluation, with source-derived vs generic classification, and a validity audit performed AFTER computation (per honest-reporting discipline, not omitted).

search_space_declared_in_advance.name: identity
search_space_declared_in_advance.role: control -- the previous run's (SEMANTIC-FUNCTOR-BRIDGE-001) failing choice, retained as baseline

search_space_declared_in_advance.name: orientation_reversed
search_space_declared_in_advance.formula: swap the two color classes' diagonal entries when |X0|=|X1| (undefined otherwise, recorded not substituted)
search_space_declared_in_advance.classification: SEED-DERIVED -- built from R's own bipartition, not a generic operation
search_space_declared_in_advance.role: tests whether the graph's own structure supplies a canonical asymmetry

search_space_declared_in_advance.name: random_diagonal_perm
search_space_declared_in_advance.formula: pi_R(a) = P pi_L(a) P^{-1} for a fixed pseudorandom permutation P (deterministic seed 999)
search_space_declared_in_advance.role: tests whether arbitrary (structureless) asymmetry alone is sufficient

post_hoc_validity_audit.finding: 'conjugate' is NOT a valid representation of A_F=C^N as a complex algebra: representations must be C-linear (pi(alpha*a)=alpha*pi(a) for complex alpha), but complex conjugation is C-antilinear (conj(alpha*a)=conjugate(alpha)*conj(a)) -- verified directly: for alpha=i, pi_R(alpha*a) != alpha*pi_R(a) to machine precision. It IS multiplicative (conj(ab)=conj(a)conj(b)) and R-linear, so it is a legitimate REAL-algebra automorphism, just not a C-algebra representation homomorphism.
post_hoc_validity_audit.identity_orientation_reversed_random_per: All three are permutation-type maps (bijective relabelings of the same spanning generator set), hence genuinely C-linear and multiplicative -- CONFIRMED valid C-algebra representations of A_F.
post_hoc_validity_audit.consequence: The three VALID candidates (identity, orientation_reversed where defined, random_diagonal_perm) constitute the rigorous test of 'genuinely different C-algebra representations of the same algebra'. 'conjugate' is retained and reported as an additional, informative data point, explicitly flagged as testing a related but distinct (R-linear/antilinear) notion of asymmetry, not a strict violation of this run's target-independence or non-fabrication rules -- it was declared in advance, computed honestly, and its technical status is reported rather than silently corrected or hidden.

orientation_reversed_undefined_cases: Undefined whenever the seed's bipartition classes have unequal size (|X0|!=|X1|), since no swap permutation exists. Recorded per-seed as UNDEFINED_FOR_THIS_SEED rather than silently falling back to another candidate. Exact counts (tested/undefined instances, out of n_seeds*2 sign conventions): N=2: 2/0 (all defined -- N=2 splits evenly as 1+1); N=3: 0/8 (all undefined -- N=3 is odd, can never split evenly); N=4: 38/8 (partially defined -- some N=4 seeds split 2+2, others 1+3); N=5: 0/462 (all undefined -- N=5 is odd, same reason as N=3). This is itself a clean, provable, general fact: orientation_reversed is defined exactly for the seeds whose bipartition happens to split evenly, which requires even N and a balanced color-class construction -- neither guaranteed nor target-conditioned, simply a consequence of testing every N this project has enumerated.
